title: Post-traumatic Growth Stronger through adversity eLearning
description: Everyone knows PTSD, but almost nobody knows the PostTraumatic Growth philosophy. Traumatic events can seriously affect your life. Whether it's getting sick, experiencing a burnout or depression, witnessing an accident, going through a divorce, losing a job, losing prospects in a job or other misfortune. It is often very intense and significant. But difficult times or misfortunes can also completely transform your life trajectory in a positive way. This is called PostTraumatic Growth in science.
